title: Australian Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful Australian-inspired rice bowl dish featuring tender meat and a variety of spices.

ingredients.name: Australian beef strips
ingredients.notes: Choose thinly sliced beef for best results

ingredients.name: oily olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: bowl of mixed greens
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite mixed greens for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Australian bush herbs
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh herbs can be used in place of dried herbs

ingredients.name: sea salt
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality sea salt for the best flavor

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Australian beef strips to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes or until browned.
Add the bush herbs and sea salt to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked brown rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the beef and herbs.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the rice is heated through.
Serve the rice mixture in a bowl topped with mixed greens.
Drizzle with additional olive oil if desired.
